text:
auto-scan-bot: [HIGH] supplychain-scan detected a critical finding in image `redwood/api:sha256:abc123`. CVE-2026-0456 (libssl buffer overflow) present in base layer. SBOM mismatch reported (manifest lists openssl 3.0.2, image contains 3.0.1). Quarantine tag applied: `redwood/api:quarantine-1872001234`

maya: Got it. Are we blocking deploys to prod? :eyes:

alex: Yes — I paused the deploy pipeline for the api service and added the quarantine tag to the registry ACLs. No new promos until triage.

linh: Triage plan: 1) prevent further deploys (done) 2) rebuild base image with patched libssl 3) regenerate SBOM and verify 4) sign image with KMS and push 5) run full integration smoke. Who can approve RBAC change for CI to sign with KMS?

chris: I can approve emergency RBAC for the CI runner. Need the exact permission set. Prefer least privilege: only key.sign / key.verify on images-signing key.

maya: Agree. Also need audit logs turned on for key usage and image push events. We should capture AM/registry events for the last 24h while we triage.

linh: Proposed command for granting sign perms (example):
```
kms grant --key projects/redwood/locations/global/keys/images-signing \
  --principal serviceAccount:ci-runner@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com \
  --roles sign
```
We'll adapt to our KMS provider.

chris: Opening PR in infra/iam with the emergency rule + expiration 48h, will request maya to approve. Also adding an audit-hook to forward key usage to our long-term audit stream.

oncall: Filing incident ticket SEC-2026-03-01. Notifying oncall and security pager. Recommended customer comms?

maya: Draft comms: "We detected a vulnerability in a base image used by one of our api services. We quarantined the affected image and initiated a rebuild with patched dependencies. There is no evidence of active exploitation. We will update once the rebuilt, signed image passes verification and is deployed." Thoughts? :loudspeaker:

chris: Send to compliance@ and support@, and include the SBOM diff in the follow-up. Legal asked for timing and scope — I'll include a short timeline.

linh: Rebuild steps (CI job):
1) base -> bump openssl to 3.0.3
2) docker build --no-cache -t redwood/api:rebuilt-187200 
3) sbom-tool generate --image redwood/api:rebuilt-187200 --format cyclonedx > sbom.json
4) ci-runner sign --key images-signing redwood/api:rebuilt-187200
5) registry push + tag prod after verification

maya: Reminder: enforce SBOM hash check in registry metadata before allowing promote. Add as a blocking gate on the release pipeline.

auto-scan-bot: [ACTION] Created ticket SEC-187200-1 for SBOM regen + CI sign job.

chris: PR up: infra#927 — emergency RBAC grant + audit forwarding. @maya please review, @linh FYI for CI config.

maya: Approved PR. Grant will auto-expire in 48h per PR.

oncall: CI run started. Monitoring logs.

auto-scan-bot: [INFO] New image `redwood/api:sha256:def456` scanned: no critical CVEs found. Signature present (kms:images-signing). SBOM matches manifest.

maya: Great — start canary deploys. Postmortem action items: 1) enforce automated SBOM-match check in pre-merge 2) add SBOM diff alerting 3) shorten KMS emergency grant workflow and document who can approve 4) review base image update cadence. I'll open postmortem doc. :memo:

chris: Adding tasks to the postmortem doc and linking the RBAC PR and registry audit logs.

linh: Closing quarantine tag after canary passes. Will run final compliance export for records.

auto-scan-bot: [CLOSED] Quarantine tag `redwood/api:quarantine-1872001234` removed at 1872004500 after verification.
